batch: Beijing official visitor information: Confucius Temple & Imperial College, Summer Palace, Temple of Heaven
scope: Official municipal, venue, and government sources reviewed for selected visitor claims. Ticketing, hours, closures, and reservation processes are dynamic and must be rechecked before travel. This is not a live ticket availability check.

records.name: Confucius Temple & Imperial College Museum
claimsReviewed: Address listed by Beijing Municipal Cultural Heritage Administration: 13–15 Guozijian Street, Dongcheng District
Museum sources describe the Confucius Temple and Imperial College as the historic temple and former imperial academy complex
Venue booking information lists seasonal hours: November–April 08:30–17:00, last ticket 16:30; May–October 08:30–18:00, last ticket 17:00
Weekly Monday closure is listed except holidays
Venue booking information describes real-name online reservations, a daily quota of 9,000, and a booking window up to three days ahead; current platform status must be checked
A municipal visitor listing reports adult admission CNY 30 and half-price CNY 15; confirm current price in the venue booking channel
A municipal visitor listing reports 09:00 opening, creating a conflict with the venue booking page 08:30 opening
records.notes: Venue booking page currently surfaced a paused reservation state during review; treat reservation availability and operational details as dynamic. Call 010-64057214 or verify the museum's official WeChat before visiting.

records.name: Summer Palace
claimsReviewed: Official municipal landscaping bureau describes the garden as 300.8 hectares and identifies Longevity Hill and Kunming Lake as principal landscape features
Main park hours: peak season April 1–October 31, 06:00–19:00 with quiet-garden time 20:00; off-season November 1–March 31, 06:30–18:00 with quiet-garden time 19:00
Separately ticketed sites have different hours from the main park
Municipal source lists main admission CNY 30 peak season and CNY 20 off-season; combined ticket CNY 60 / CNY 50
Some individually ticketed sites close Mondays except statutory holidays
Official municipal visitor guide provides passport-based foreign visitor booking guidance; confirm the current channel and terms
records.notes: Hours for park gates and paid sites differ. The official visitor guide is the operational reference; seasonal details and booking requirements should be rechecked.

records.name: Temple of Heaven
claimsReviewed: Official Beijing data page lists address as No. 1A Tiantan Road, Dongcheng District
Park hours: peak season April 1–October 31, 06:00–22:00; off-season November 1–March 31, 06:30–22:00; last entry 21:00
Paid scenic buildings have separate hours: 08:00–18:00 peak season and 08:00–17:00 off-season
Main paid scenic buildings close Mondays except statutory holidays
Official visitor guide describes park-only and combined ticket prices and passport-based booking through the official ticketing channel; verify current booking steps
records.notes: The park remains open longer than its paid buildings. Do not describe the park's 22:00 closing as the opening time of the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests or other paid sites.
